about: Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury is a united-townships municipality in the Jacques-Cartier highlands immediately north of Québec City—not a borough of the capital. Stoneham Mountain Resort, forested valleys, and cottage lakes define this Laurentian-edge community. About 10,000 people live in Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury.
seoSummary: United townships north of Québec City—Stoneham ski resort and Jacques-Cartier highland forests, not the capital.
